name: UsageCard
label: Usage card
description: An agent's budgets at a glance: context window and plan limits as meter rows with reset captions.

props.name: items
props.description: The budgets to show, one meter row each

props.name: title
props.description:
Card title in the shared chart-chrome header.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which UsageCard does not expose.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Fractions of an item's max where its fill recolours to warning and then error

props.name: bare
props.description: Chrome off (no border, padding, or fill) for use inside a panel that supplies the surface

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale each meter's readout is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to `en-US`. This component can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.

UsageItem.description: One budgeted quantity in the card — a meter row with an optional reset caption.
